Offline, by hand at the Caretaking Branch, DC Office Complex, Nand Nagri

content_sections.heading: About DM North East Delhi
content_sections.text: The Office of the District Magistrate, District (North East) Delhi, is based at the D.C. Office Complex, Nand Nagri, Delhi-93. Its One Stop Centre for District North-East works out of Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital, Shastri Park, Delhi. Under the One Stop Centre Scheme, the centre runs under the guidelines of the Ministry of Women & Child Development.

content_sections.heading: About the One Stop Centre
content_sections.text: The notice says One Stop Centres support women affected by violence in private and public spaces, including within the family, in the community and at work. The centre helps women facing physical, sexual, emotional, psychological or economic abuse, whatever their age, class, caste, education, marital status, race or culture. It offers specialised services to women affected by attempted sexual harassment, sexual assault, domestic violence, trafficking, honour-related crimes, acid attacks or witch-hunting who come to the centre or are referred to it. content_sections.heading: DM North East Delhi Centre Administrator Vacancy Details 2026
DM North East Delhi Centre Administrator Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The notice is open only to female candidates who are residents of Delhi. A Masters in Law/ Social Work/ Sociology/ Social Science/ Psychology. At least 5 years of experience working on women-related issues in an administrative set-up with a Government or Non-Government project or programme. At least 1 year of counselling experience, either within the same set-up or outside it. Being a resident of the local community. For the full eligibility conditions for this post, see Annexure-I of the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria will be told the date and time of the interview by email and through a public notice on the office website. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The post is on a contractual basis, at first for one year. The contract may be extended if the annual performance appraisal is satisfactory and the candidate has vigilance clearance. Extensions follow the Ministry of Women & Child Development guidelines in force at the time. The place of work is the One Stop Centre, District North-East, at Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital, Shastri Park, Delhi.

faq.question: Q1. Can men apply for the Centre Administrator post?
faq.answer: No. The post is for women only, and applicants must be residents of Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. Where will the Centre Administrator work?
faq.answer: At the One Stop Centre, District North-East, which works out of Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital, Shastri Park, Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. Which subjects are accepted for the Master's degree?
faq.answer: Law, Social Work, Sociology, Social Science or Psychology.

faq.question: Q4. Is counselling experience compulsory?
faq.answer: No. At least 1 year of counselling experience is preferred. The required experience is 5 years of work on women-related issues in an administrative set-up of a Government or Non-Government project or programme.

faq.question: Q5. Can I send the application by post or email?
faq.answer: No. You must hand in the application in person at the Caretaking Branch, B-Block, 1st Floor, DC Office Complex, Nand Nagri, Delhi-110093.

faq.question: Q6. What should I write on the envelope?
faq.answer: Your name, the post you are applying for and your address. Seal the self-attested form and documents in one envelope.

faq.question: Q7. How will I find out the interview date?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates will be told by email and through a public notice on dmnortheast.delhi.gov.in. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: At first, one year. It may be extended if your annual performance appraisal is satisfactory and you have vigilance clearance, under the Ministry of Women & Child Development guidelines.
